To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Rhode Island Access to Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

-the annual salary / total compensation for each Parole Board member for 2026

I am making this request for research purposes and am not a journalist.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jacob Wourms

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Public Records Request – Coastal Pest Control of the Treasure Coast, license # JB5594
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under Chapter 119, Florida Statutes, I request copies of the following public records concerning Coastal Pest Control [exact licensed name], pest control business license no. [ ]:
All certificates of insurance filed with the Department under Section 482.071(4), Florida Statutes, in effect on August 3, 2026, including any renewals or replacements filed since January 1, 2026.
All documents filed with the Department evidencing financial responsibility for wood-destroying organism inspections under Section 482.226, Florida Statutes, including any errors-and-omissions policy, certificate, or bond, in effect on August 3, 2026.
The identity of the certified operator(s) in charge for the license on August 3, 2026, and records showing that the license authorized termite and wood-destroying organism inspections on that date.
Records showing the identification card status on August 3, 2026, of Jason Falkner, ID No. JE66173.
Records of any closed complaints, investigations, notices of noncompliance, or administrative actions concerning this licensee from January 1, 2021 to the present.
Electronic copies by email are preferred. If the fees will exceed $50, please send me an estimate before processing. If any record or part of a record is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exemption, as Section 119.07(1)(e) requires.
Thank you,
Donna Barfield
barfielddonna@yahoo.com
 If there are fees please send request to my email barfielddonna@yahoo.com.  I look forward to your response within 7 days.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Donna Barfield
